test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given underlined idiom.

The construction of the office building of the company was taking place __in leaps and bounds__.

options.text: Stopped due to some legal issues

solution:
The correct answer is: **'****Progressing very quickly**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"in leaps and bounds"** means:

 
 
• Progressing very quickly (बहुत तेजी से प्रगति करना)
 
 
 
• **Example:** The company's profits have been increasing **in leaps and bounds** since the new CEO took over.

 
• The correct word **"Progressing very quickly"** means:

 
 
• Advancing or developing at a rapid pace (तेजी से आगे बढ़ना)
 
 
 
• **Example:** The technology in the field of artificial intelligence is **progressing very quickly**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Stopped due to some legal issues** (कानूनी मुद्दों के कारण रोका गया):

 
 
• **Example:** The construction was **stopped due to some legal issues** regarding the land ownership.
 
 
 
• **Broken because of negligence** (लापरवाही के कारण टूटा हुआ):
 
 
• **Example:** The machine was **broken because of negligence** in maintenance.
 
 
 
• **Moving very slowly** (बहुत धीरे-धीरे चल रहा है):
 
 
• **Example:** The project is **moving very slowly** because of a lack of resources.
